source.title: Clogher Rural District, "Notice of Result of Elections: Election of Rural District Councillors for the above-named Rural District in the Year 1902", dated 5 June 1902, Claude C. Hamilton, returning officer (PRONI LA/24/3/AD/1; the owner's photographs of 10 November 2026, frames 399 and 401)
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Clogher Rural District Council records)
source.check: read from the owner's photographs of the printed notice in two blind transcriptions by separate readers, which agreed on every name, figure and mark; a script checked that each division elects as many as its seats and that the elected are the top of the poll; abodes are not published

note: Triennial election of the rural district council, held with the election of the board of guardians: each district electoral division returned its councillors, who were also its guardians. Polled Wednesday 4 June 1902 ("Polling for the election of County and Rural District Councillors for Tyrone took place on Wednesday last": Tyrone Constitution, 6 June 1902, p. 5). Cole returned 2 councillors, unopposed. The notice prints the first member as "Colonel Knox Browne", with no forenames.
